name: lint
on: [pull_request]
jobs:
  lint-shard-1:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: python3 .github/scripts/verify-alpha.py
      - run: python3 .github/scripts/verify-beta.py
      - run: python3 .github/scripts/verify-beta.py --self-test
      - run: python3 .github/scripts/verify-gamma.py
      - run: bash .github/scripts/delta-tests/run-tests.sh
      - run: python3 .github/scripts/verify-epsilon.py
tree..github/scripts/verify-alpha.py:
"""Reads alpha.yml by an os.path.join."""
import os
ROOT = "."
open(os.path.join(ROOT, ".github", "workflows", "alpha.yml")).read()
print("ok")

"""Reads alpha.yml through a helper module, and docs/beta.md."""
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, ".github/scripts")
from wc_fixture_lib import load_alpha
load_alpha()
open("docs/beta.md").read()
print("ok")

"""Reads gamma.yml. This docstring names .github/workflows/alpha.yml,
which the gate never opens, so a change to alpha.yml must not pick it."""
open(".github/workflows/gamma.yml").read()
print("ok")

"""Sweeps every .py beside it, and lists the workflows, through a name
bound to its own directory."""
import glob
import os
HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
glob.glob(os.path.join(HERE, "**", "*.py"), recursive=True)
os.listdir(os.path.join(HERE, "..", "workflows"))
print("ok")
